pre_mortem: It is Monday and the DAL@NYG card lost. Tracy stayed under 53.5 rush-plus-rec because Week 1 was a Singletary split, the uncharted Dallas front stuffed the run, and the recent 57-yard combo game showed the line is only a few yards from a miss when receiving is negative. The 2025 hot streak of 70, 71, 62 and 103 rush yards was a different offense, and with no coach check and no no-vig we cannot prove 53.5 was ever a bad number. Ferguson cleared 33.5 because the Giants' uncharted pressure made him the Dallas safety valve, one chunk play erased a 16, 19, 6, 5 sample, and 33.5 was the market's real Week 1 role rather than last year's cold streak. Missing MetLife weather and missing 90-minute inactives, especially Nabers' knee, are the other ways this read was blind.
